positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 20.8% below its local comparables; 6 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (14.4): 3.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 15 of 108 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 79.2% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2010.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

near the peer median (its range includes it)

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,250,000 ($1,578 psf, 710–882 sq ft; 11 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,845 psf (range $1,461–2,008); 14.5% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $212,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $1,810,000 ($1,586 psf, 1,140 sq ft; 6 resales, Feb 2024–Jan 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,176 psf (range $2,015–2,325); 27.1% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $673,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Hougang MRT about 780 m, Kovan MRT about 1,170 m; closer than 38 of 116 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest Holy Innocents' Primary School about 380 m; more than 39 of 116 similar developments (the same as 35). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 190 m), more than 54 of 116 similar developments (the same as 26); nearest hawker centre Kovan Hougang Market And Food Centre about 1,150 m; nearest park Punggol Park about 1,250 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Kovan Hougang Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming: Defu MRT (Cross Island Line) about 300 m, under construction; LTA target 2030. Straight-line distance to the planned station site; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: No other condo development sold new homes within 2 km. Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 65 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 0 new sales and 670 resales (670 purchases); new sales were 0% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 670 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 103 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 670 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 692 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−3.2%). Planning-area private resales −7.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
